c: Bone duck legs (≈ 900 g meat); keep 300 g in 1 cm dice; mince the rest with pork and livers 6 mm.
Marinate dice with brandy and zest 12 h. Mix mince with salts, egg, shallots and spices; fold in dice and pistachios.
Pack into a lined terrine; cover; bake in a water bath 150 °C to core 68 °C (≈ 1 h 30 min).
Press with 1 kg weight; chill 24 h.
Season with salt, sugar, pepper and wine; press into a block; cure covered 12 h at 0–3 °C.
Roll tightly in film into 5 cm logs; poach 65 °C to core 52 °C (≈ 12 min); ice bath; hang 24 h.
Hocks raw 3000 g → picked meat ≈ 1000 g
Soak hocks 12 h; simmer with vegetables, bay and wine 3 h until the bone pulls out; pick meat in chunks.
Reduce 600 ml strained stock; add soaked gelatine, vinegar and mustard.
Layer warm meat with chopped parsley and shallot in a lined terrine; pour over the stock; press lightly; chill 24 h.
cc36f71f.al: 10 Mustard (dijon mustard) · 14 Sulphites (white wine, white wine vinegar)

c: Poach chicken in stock 80 °C to core 82 °C; pull into chunks; reduce stock to 400 ml; dissolve gelatine.
Blanch leeks whole 6 min; shock; dry.
Layer chicken, leeks and chopped tarragon in a film-lined terrine with the warm stock; press 1 kg; chill 24 h.
Roast peppers 230 °C until charred; peel. Slice aubergine and zucchini lengthways 6 mm; oil; grill.
Warm stock; dissolve gelatine; brush each layer.
Layer vegetables, basil and crumbled goat cheese in a film-lined terrine; press 2 kg; chill 24 h.
Line terrine with film then overlapping salmon slices (keep 200 g for the centre).
Blanch leeks until soft; shock; split into sheets.
Beat cream cheese, sour cream, dill, zest and melted gelatine.
Layer cream, leeks and salmon; fold salmon over; press lightly; chill 12 h.
c83ca54f.al: 4 Fish (smoked salmon) · 7 Milk (cream cheese, sour cream 20%)

c: Grate raw beetroot; mix with salt, sugar, vodka, chopped dill, crushed pepper and zest.
Pin-bone salmon; pack in cure in a tray; cover and weight.
Rinse, pat dry; trim the dark edge; slice 3 mm on the bias (80 g per portion).
eacbc907.al: 1 Gluten (rye bread) · 4 Fish (salmon fillet) · 7 Milk (crème fraîche 30%). Raw fish/shellfish: sashimi grade, previously frozen (−20 °C 24 h).

c: Use salmon frozen at −20 °C for at least 24 h (parasite control), thawed at 0–4 °C.
Remove pin bones with tweezers; pat the surface dry.
Mix salt and sugar evenly; spread over all surfaces of the fillet.
Place skin-side down in a GN container, cover tightly; cure 18–24 h at 0–4 °C.
Wipe off the cure and pat dry.
Leave uncovered at 0–4 °C for 2–6 h to firm.
Slice thinly at an angle just before service.

8b49e083.yl: Yield: 4 breasts ≈ 800 g cured · 26 portions × 30 g
c: Trim sinew; bury breasts in salt, sugar and herbs 18 h at 0–3 °C.
Rinse; dry; roll in cracked pepper.
Wrap in muslin; hang at 0–3 °C (or 12 °C, 75 % humidity) 10–14 days until firm and 30 % lighter.

fcc80987.yl: Yield: ≈ 2.1 kg cured · for cooking (lardons, carbonara)
c: Square the belly. Cure = 2.8 % salt + 0.25 % curing salt + 1.2 % sugar of meat weight, plus crushed spices.
Vacuum; cure 0–3 °C 10 days, turning every 2 days.
Rinse; dry; coat with cracked pepper; hang at 0–3 °C 2 weeks until firm (15 % loss).

9722c0ae.yl: Yield: 1 piece ≈ 1.2 kg after drying · 40 portions × 30 g
c: Trim all sinew. Weigh; cure = 2.5 % salt + 0.25 % curing salt + 1 % sugar of meat weight.
Rub cure and crushed aromatics in; vacuum with wine; cure 0–3 °C 14 days, turning every 2 days.
Rinse; dry; wrap in muslin; hang at 12–14 °C, 75–80 % humidity until 40 % weight loss (3–5 weeks).
Batch · from 1000 g whole frozen mackerel · Yield 540 g
Use only mackerel frozen to a core of −20 °C for at least 24 h, or −35 °C for at least 15 h (parasite control). Keep the supplier freezing certificate on file; reject the delivery without it.
Thaw at 0–4 °C for 12–14 h. Never thaw in water or at room temperature.

Head, gut and remove the gills; scrape out the black membrane. Fillet along the backbone, remove the pin bones and keep the skin. Rinse in cold water, drain and pat dry. 1000 g whole fish gives about 620 g fillet.
Mix the salt, sugar, coriander, pepper and bay (4 % salt and 1 % sugar of the fillet weight).
Rub the cure evenly over flesh and skin. Lay the fillets flesh to flesh in a perforated GN over a solid pan, cover with film and cure at 2–4 °C for 14 h.
Rinse off the cure under cold water and pat dry. Brush lightly with the oil (weight loss in cure 10–13 %).
Slice on the bias at 45°, 3–4 mm thick; 90 g per portion. Serve at 4–6 °C.
97c73418.st: Vacuum-packed or covered, 0–4 °C, 5 days from end of cure. Label with production and use-by date. Not for refreezing.

c: Mince chilled pork and fat 5 mm (meat and blade at 0–2 °C).
Mix with crumbs, iced water, sage and seasoning 2 min until sticky; fry a test patty.
Fill casings firmly; twist 75 g links; dry uncovered overnight at 0–3 °C.
Cook to order: grill or pan 12–14 min to core 72 °C.
Sweat onion; cool; mix with mince, grated apple, crumbs, herbs and seasoning.
Pipe a 3 cm log along 12 cm pastry strips; egg-wash edge; roll; seal; chill 30 min.
Cut 6 cm; egg-wash; score; sesame; bake 200 °C 25 min to core 72 °C.
f7d68ead.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs, puff pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (puff pastry) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds)

87333d65.yl: Yield: 1 pie 20 cm (≈ 2 kg) · 16 slices × 125 g
c: Hand-dice half the shoulder 1 cm; mince the rest with belly 8 mm; mix with bacon and seasoning; chill.
Boil water and lard; pour into flour and salt; knead warm.
Line a springform with 2/3 of the pastry; fill; lid; crimp; steam hole; egg-wash.
Bake 200 °C 30 min, then 160 °C to core 72 °C (≈ 1 h 15 min).
Dissolve gelatine in warm stock; pour into the cooled pie through the hole; chill 12 h.
Use only salmon belly that has been frozen at −20 °C for at least 24 h (parasite control) — the confit below is not a full cook.
Trim the bellies of skin remnants and membrane. Brine 20 min in the 5 % brine (water + brine salt); drain and pat dry.
Cover completely with the olive oil in a shallow tray. Confit at 45–50 °C for 20–25 min, until the flesh flakes but has not curdled.
Lift out and drain on a rack. Strain and reserve the oil.
Macerate the shallot in the lemon juice for 10 min.
Cream the soft butter with the cream cheese until smooth (both at room temperature).
Flake the warm bellies with a fork into strands, not paste.
Fold one third of the fish into the butter base, then the rest, keeping the fibres intact. No blender or cutter.
Fold in the smoked salmon, shallot with lemon, zest and herbs. Season with the salt, white pepper and cayenne.
Press into terrine moulds without air pockets; seal with 3 mm clarified butter. Chill to \< 5 °C within 90 min and set at least 12 h at 0–4 °C.
Quenelle 60 g per portion; serve with warm toasted brioche and pickled cucumber.
Buffet: ceramic dish under the butter seal on the cold section, with a dedicated spoon; max 2 h at ≤ 5 °C.
8e988537.st: Sealed: 0–4 °C, 3 days. After opening: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Label every terrine with production date. Not suitable for freezing.
8e988537.al: 4 Fish · 7 Milk. Accompaniments: brioche 1 Gluten · 3 Eggs · 7 Milk; pickled cucumber 14 Sulphites (check label).

c: Boil 12 eggs 6 min 15 s; ice; peel.
Season mince with sage, mustard, salt and pepper; flatten 75 g per egg; wrap evenly.
Fry 170 °C 6 min; finish 180 °C 4 min to core 72 °C in the meat; rest 2 min.
42aa0f76.st: Raw coated 0–3 °C 24 h; cooked 0–3 °C 2 days (yolk sets).
42aa0f76.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, panko) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 10 Mustard (english mustard)

c: Rub cucumbers (3–6 cm) in a cloth; salt 24 h; rinse; dry.
Pack into sterile jars with shallots, tarragon and spices.
Pour over boiled vinegar, water and sugar at 80 °C; seal; mature 3 weeks.
db096e0d.st: Sealed dark & cool 6 months; opened 0–3 °C 2 months.

c: Simmer everything 50–60 min, stirring, until thick and glossy (a spoon leaves a trail).
Remove cinnamon; jar hot; mature 1 week.
Cut vegetables in even 1.5 cm pieces.
Boil vinegar, water, sugar, salt, bay and pepper.
Cook vegetables in the brine in order of hardness (carrot 4 min, cauliflower, celery, beans 3 min, peppers 2 min); keep crunchy.
Jar hot with brine; add onions and a film of oil; cool; 48 h before use.
2f9faf1d.al: 9 Celery (celery) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar). Vegan. Contains 14 Sulphites (vinegar).

c: Soak seeds in vinegar and wine 48 h at room temperature.
Blitz one-third to a paste; mix with the rest, honey, salt and turmeric.
Cut vegetables 1 cm; salt 12 h; rinse; drain.
Boil 500 ml vinegar with sugar and mustard seeds.
Whisk starch, mustard, turmeric and remaining vinegar; whisk into the boiling vinegar; cook 3 min until thick.
Fold in vegetables; jar hot; mature 1 week.
40ec74af.st: Sealed jars dark & cool 6 months; opened 0–3 °C 4 weeks.

d13868fb.yl: Yield: 10 portions · ≈ 500 g drained · Portion: 50 g
c: Wash the cucumbers and slice 2–3 mm thick.
Toss with the pre-salting salt, leave 15–20 min, then drain off the liquid.
Bring water, vinegar, sugar and brine salt to the boil; add spices, dill and garlic and boil 1–2 min.
Cool the brine to 80–85 °C and pour over the cucumbers (60–70 °C gives a crisper slice, 95 °C a softer one).
Cool to below 21 °C within 2 h, then chill to 0–4 °C; marinate at least 12 h before service.
For longer storage: fill sterile jars, seal and pasteurise at 90 °C for 5–7 min, then cool quickly.
d13868fb.st: 0–4 °C, 14 days in brine; pasteurised sealed jars 0–4 °C, 30 days (14 days after opening). Not suitable for freezing.

240d5010.yl: Yield: 75 portions · ≈ 1500 g drained · Portion: 20 g
c: Trim the root ends and grade the cloves by size.
Blanch 1 min in boiling water (100 °C); shock in iced water to below 5 °C and drain.
Bring water, vinegar, salt, sugar and spices to the boil and boil 2 min.
Pack the garlic into sterile jars and cover with brine at a minimum of 85 °C.
Seal tightly and cool quickly: below 21 °C within 2 h, then 0–4 °C.
Mature at least 48 h at 0–4 °C; best after 5–7 days.
Check pH of the finished product: 3.4–3.8 (must be ≤ 4.2).
240d5010.st: Sealed jars 0–4 °C, 60 days; once opened 0–4 °C, 14 days. Not suitable for freezing.
240d5010.al: None of the 14 listed allergens. Vinegar: check label (14 Sulphites).

c: Trim; halve large mushrooms; blanch 2 min in salted water; drain well.
Boil vinegar, water, sugar, salt and aromatics 2 min.
Pour over mushrooms; cool; top with oil; mature 2 days.

a4b97b6b.yl: Yield: 20 portions · ≈ 1000 g drained · Portion: 50 g
c: Cut the onion into half-moons and pack into a clean container.
Bring water, vinegar, salt, sugar and spices to the boil.
Pour the marinade over the onion at 80–90 °C.
When the marinade has dropped below 70 °C, pour the oil over the top.
Cool to below 21 °C within 2 h, then to 0–4 °C; marinate 6–8 h at 0–4 °C.
a4b97b6b.st: 0–4 °C, 14 days in marinade, covered and labelled. Not suitable for freezing.

c: Slice onions thin; cook in oil, covered, low heat 30 min until soft.
Add sugar; cook uncovered 20 min to deep caramel.
Add wine, balsamic and thyme; reduce to a jammy consistency 25 min; season; jar.
Peel, core and dice pears 1 cm; dice onion; grate ginger.
Simmer everything 45 min until thick, stirring often.
Slice zucchini and eggplant 5 mm; grill on a hot plancha 1–2 min per side.
Marinate in oil, garlic, parsley and salt 1 h.
Fold cured meats loosely; break Parmesan into rough chunks.
Arrange meats, cheeses, grilled vegetables, peppers, artichokes and olives in groups on a board.
Garnish with basil; serve with focaccia or grissini; keep chilled ≤ 2 h on the buffet.
3bd7e9cd.st: Components 0–4 °C; platter max 2 h at room temperature.
3bd7e9cd.al: 7 Milk (bocconcini, parmesan). Cured meats: check label.

1ee40371.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 140 g (5 cheeses + jam)
c: Temper cheeses 45–60 min before service (served at 16–18 °C).
Cut 24 g per cheese per plate, rind on, in shapes matching the cheese (wedges, shards, slices).
Arrange mild to strong clockwise (Manchego → blue); jam in a ramekin.
1ee40371.st: Cheeses: 4–8 °C, wrapped in cheese paper; cut faces covered. Jam: 0–4 °C after opening.
1ee40371.al: 7 Milk (manchego, aged sheep cheese, blue cheese, sheep cheese, aged cheese). Serve with bread/crackers on request (1 Gluten).

c: Slice jamón by hand (thin, 4–5 cm, with fat) and cecina to order; lomo and chorizo 2 mm on the slicer.
Plate 35 g each at room temperature (18–22 °C) so the fat is translucent.
Never stack; arrange in waves; serve within 15 min of slicing.
83bb4715.st: Whole leg on stand: room temp, cut face covered with its own fat. Lomo/chorizo: 4–8 °C, opened 7 days.
83bb4715.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Chorizo/lomo may contain 7 Milk or 6 Soy (check label).
